headline: Capital market firms see market cap surge by ₹1.2 lakh crore in 2024
hook: Market infrastructure stocks defy recent volatility
summary: Stocks of exchanges, depositories, and asset management companies have collectively added ₹1.2 trillion in market value during 2024. This surge persists even as the broader Indian equity market faces recent corrections and volatility. The growth is primarily driven by increasing retail participation and steady inflows through systematic investment plans. Investors are increasingly betting on the long-term structural shift of Indian household savings into financial assets.
whats_next: Quarterly earnings reports from major exchanges and depositories
why_it_matters: Market-linked service providers remain profitable despite broader volatility.

headline: Fintech stocks rally up to 11% following RBI's account aggregator interoperability move
hook: Frictionless data sharing for account aggregator users
summary: Shares of fintech firms including Pine Labs and Moneyview rose by up to 11% after the Reserve Bank of India announced interoperability among NBFC account aggregators. The new framework allows customers to share their financial information across different account aggregators using a single account without requiring fresh registration, subject to their consent. This policy change streamlines data access for financial service providers and users alike. Indian retail investors holding fintech or NBFC-backed stocks benefit from increased user adoption and operational efficiency.
whats_next: Implementation guidelines from RBI on account aggregator interoperability
why_it_matters: Fintech stocks surge on easier customer data sharing across platforms.
winners_losers: Fintech firms gain / traditional data silos hurt

headline: Nuvama prefers CAMS and HDFC AMC over BSE and CDSL
hook: Nuvama favors asset managers over market infrastructure
summary: Brokerage firm Nuvama has identified CAMS and HDFC AMC as its top picks within the financial services sector. The firm suggests these asset management and registry stocks offer better value compared to market infrastructure players like BSE and CDSL. This recommendation comes amidst a broader period of market weakness. Retail investors holding these stocks may see shifting sentiment based on this brokerage preference.
why_it_matters: Brokerage preference may influence short-term price action in these stocks.
winners_losers: CAMS and HDFC AMC gain / BSE and CDSL hurt

headline: CAMS allots 90,305 securities under its employee stock option plan
summary: Computer Age Management Services Limited has allotted 90,305 securities pursuant to its employee stock option scheme (ESOP/ESPS). The allotment was approved via circular resolution on October 1, 2026. This routine corporate action marginally increases the total paid-up equity base of the company. For Indian retail investors, ESOP allotments dilute existing shareholding by a fractional amount.
why_it_matters: Slight equity dilution for existing shareholders.
